audit_methods: Pattern checks for semantic HTML, keyboard traps, labels, reflow, motion, AEO structure, and site-level agent-readiness files when a directory is scanned
Runtime behavior, contrast ratios, and screen-reader task completion were not fully verified

findings.legal_exposure: This criterion is at A/AA level, within the range most tracked jurisdictions' technical standards cover (e.g. WCAG 2.1 AA, EN 301 549, JIS X 8341-3, KWCAG 2.2, GB/T 37668), including: United States, European Union, Japan, Taiwan, Canada, Australia, China (Mainland), South Korea, Hong Kong SAR, Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Ecuador. This is a summary-level technical mapping, not a jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction legal determination; actual exposure depends on deployment context, target market, and whether that jurisdiction's rule is currently in force.
findings.title: Contrast not verified, run Tier 2
findings.affected_users: Low-vision users and users in high ambient light
findings.description: This run only scanned static markup/CSS. No browser-rendered contrast evidence (Beacon-native tier2-audit.mjs or axe-core) was merged in, so real computed-style contrast was never exercised by a rendering engine.
findings.fix: Run node scripts/tier2-audit.mjs (default) or an axe-core pass, then fold its findings in with --merge-findings for verified contrast coverage.

legal_risk.narrative: Technical WCAG criteria mapping only. This is not a legal opinion and is not derived from warning counts.

testing_recommendations.zh: 用 Beacon 原生的 tier2-audit.mjs（預設）或 axe-core 驗證計算後的文字與 UI 對比。
testing_recommendations.en: Verify computed text and UI contrast with Beacon-native tier2-audit.mjs (default) or axe-core.

testing_recommendations.zh: 在 320px 寬度與實際 200% 瀏覽器縮放下分別重跑主要流程，保留操作結果；靜態掃描本身不能證明回流或縮放已通過。
testing_recommendations.en: Repeat the primary flow at 320px width and, separately, at actual 200% browser zoom. Record both results; a static scan alone does not establish that reflow or zoom passed.

testing_recommendations.zh: 請一位不熟悉產品的使用者完成主要任務，觀察標籤、說明與下一步是否清楚。
testing_recommendations.en: Ask a user unfamiliar with the product to complete the primary task and observe whether labels, help, and next steps are clear.
